title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 12B: Plans and collocations
subtitle: Common verbs and collocations from 12B

words.def: to do slow exercises for your body and mind
words.sent: I’m going to ___ at the gym on Monday.

words.def: to do the work your teacher gives you for home
words.sent: You can’t watch TV. ___ first!

words.def: to wash your clothes
words.sent: My clothes are dirty. I’m going to ___.

words.def: to play football, tennis, run and so on
words.sent: I want to be healthy, so I ___ three times a week.

words.def: to cook a sweet food for a birthday
words.sent: It’s Mum’s birthday. I’m going to ___ for her.

words.def: to write things on paper one under the other
words.sent: Before I go shopping, I ___ of the food I need.

words.def: to cook the meal in the middle of the day
words.sent: It’s 12 o’clock. I’m going to ___ for the children.

words.def: to ask someone to come to a party
words.sent: It’s my birthday on Saturday. I want to ___ — my friend Lan.

words.def: to ask someone to eat with you
words.sent: I’m going to ___ at my flat — I’m cooking pasta.

words.def: to go to see a friend at their home
words.sent: I’m going to ___ in hospital — she’s ill.

words.def: to travel to the capital of France
words.sent: We’re going to ___ and see the Eiffel Tower.

words.def: to make a picture with colours
words.sent: I’m going to ___ of the sea for my room.

words.def: to put new colour on the side of a room
words.sent: The kitchen is old. I’m going to ___ yellow.

words.def: to make your home not dirty
words.sent: My parents are visiting! I need to ___.

words.def: to wash the glass so you can see out
words.sent: I can’t see outside. I’m going to ___.

words.def: to go online on a computer or phone
words.sent: I ___ to find information for my homework.

words.def: to walk outside for fun
words.sent: It’s a beautiful day. Let’s ___ in the park.

words.def: to go to shops to buy things
words.sent: I need new shoes. I’m going to ___ on Saturday.

words.def: to go to the sand next to the sea
words.sent: It’s hot! Let’s ___ and swim.

words.def: a question about a plan for the future
words.sent: ___ visit your parents this weekend? — Yes, I am.
